description: This file defines multiple Retrofit service interfaces for making API calls related to likes, content, and APA metadata/assets in an Android TV frontend application.

classes.name: LikesService
classes.description: Defines API endpoints for retrieving and submitting 'like' statuses for media groups.

classes.name: ContentService
classes.description: Defines API endpoint for fetching content information including titles and images.

classes.name: APAService
classes.description: Defines API endpoints for retrieving APA metadata and assets.

methods.name: getLike
methods.description: Suspends function to retrieve existing like status for a given media group ID.

methods.name: postLike
methods.description: Suspends function to submit a like for a given media group ID.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Suspends function to get content details including title and images for a media group ID.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Suspends function to retrieve APA metadata including legend keys and settings.

methods.name: getAssets
methods.description: Suspends function to retrieve APA assets like icons.
